title: Surge playbook check-ins — UI / Rollouts / Analytics — 2026-06-25
content:
Meeting context:
Quick check-in for the surge playbook rehearsal focusing on UI rollouts, analytics pipeline health, and guardrail automation. Short call (30m) to validate actions from last week's drill and to record follow-ups.

Attendees:
- Maya H. (owner)
- Liam O.
- Priya P.
- Samir R.
- Zoe K.
- Elena G. (observability) — joined for analytics section

High-level goals for this session:
1) Verify canary fallback flow for ui-v2 when analytics ingestion lag spikes
2) Validate automated flag rollback works when error-rate crosses threshold
3) Confirm observability dashboards surface the right signals for on-call

Quick metrics snapshot at 11:00 PDT (from dashboards):
- UI v2 p95 render time (canary Hosts): 320ms (baseline p95 v1 = 240ms)
- Error rate (5m window) for UI v2: 0.8% (alert threshold configured at 1.5%)
- Analytics ingestion lag: median 45s, 95th = 3m10s (target 95th < 2m) — backlog processing catching up
- Dashboard event counts: telemetry events delivered 98.4% within 60s

Updates (by owner):
- Maya: finished the surge-playbook draft, pushed checklist to Confluence (linked). Added explicit step for switching to legacy render path (flag: ui.use_legacy_render). Still needs runbook steps for SRE during rollback.
- Liam: Feature-flag orchestration changes merged in PR #821. Canary rollout script updated to include graceful draining of new hosts. Noted a race where feature gate toggles reach multiple regions out of order — will add region-coordination mutex.
- Priya: UI telemetry schema v2 landed. Noticed two events missing user_id in ~0.05% of messages when queue got overloaded. Instrumented a quick fix to drop and backfill later; will follow up with a small migration job.
- Samir: Analytics pipeline scaling rule updated — autoscaler now respects backlog age as a dimension. During the rehearsal we observed scaling lag in EKS HPA, investigating if the custom metric export is mis-sampled.
- Zoe: Dashboard tweaks live: added a combined "canary-health" panel that shows p95 latency, error rate, and ingestion lag. Also added an action link to trigger the rollback playbook from the dashboard (requires SSO + permission check).

Blockers and risks:
- Backfill job risk: if the job runs while canary is active it will add noise to metrics. Priya to gate backfill by a time window and separate metric tag. (Owner: Priya, due 2026-06-28)
- Region coordination for the feature flag (race condition): could cause partial rollouts to overshoot traffic in some regions. Liam to implement mutex + test harness. (Owner: Liam, due 2026-07-02)
- Autoscaler metric delay: affects HPA reaction time, observed ~30–45s lag before extra nodes show up on heavy backlogs. Samir to debug exporter and consider temporary lower thresholds. (Owner: Samir, due 2026-06-29)

Decisions made:
- Keep canary at 10% traffic for an additional 24h for ui-v2 while we stabilize telemetry counts.
- If ingestion lag 95th > 4m OR UI v2 error rate > 2% for 5m continuously, trigger automated rollback to ui-v1 (via feature flag).
- Dashboards will surface a combined heat signal (canary-health) with explicit per-region breakdowns — Zoe to standardize color thresholds.

Runbook action items (critical path):
1) Automated rollback test: create a synthetic test that simulates backlog spike and validates rollback flow end-to-end (includes feature flag flip, host drain, and traffic routing). (Owner: Maya & Liam, due 2026-07-01)
2) Add telemetry tagging to backfill artifacts so analytics can filter them out of SLA signals. (Owner: Priya, due 2026-06-28)
3) HPA exporter reliability: add a redundancy exporter pod and increase scraping frequency during drills. (Owner: Samir, due 2026-06-29)
4) Dashboard action auth: work with security to ensure dashboard-triggered rollbacks only show for appropriate roles. (Owner: Zoe + Security, due 2026-07-03)

Loose notes / parking lot:
- Consider adding a synthetic traffic generator in staging to more frequently exercise rollback path. Could be run nightly. (Prototype: ENGCON-495)
- Long term: move the canary decision into the router layer so it can make per-user rollout decisions (complex, backlog: product discussion).
- Investigate whether KV cache warmup for ui-v2 contributes to p95 delta — profiling planned. (Owner: Maya)

Wrap-up / next check-in:
- Quick status sync scheduled for 2026-06-29 (15m) to confirm owners progressed on blockers. Full rehearsal (30–45m) planned for 2026-07-02 to validate automated rollback and region-mutex under simulated surge.

Notes saved to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/67890
Jira tickets referenced: ENGCON-482, ROLL-210, ENGCON-495
PR reference: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/821

Action summary (single-line):
- Priya: telemetry backfill gating + tags (due 06/28)
- Liam: feature-flag region mutex + tests (due 07/02)
- Samir: exporter/HPA reliability fixes (due 06/29)
- Maya: create automated rollback synthetic test with Liam (due 07/01)
- Zoe: finalize dashboard thresholds and auth for rollback action (due 07/03)

End of notes.
